description: Iteration 2: ranked failure modes of the current blend S3 on dev, by physical cause of the move in the posted-offer median. Each entry stands alone.

modes.name: Offer enters the panel
modes.definition: The median moves because a provider's offer appears near the middle of the panel and composition outweighs repricing.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Partly. A provider listing the same GPU and tier on the other collector but absent here raises the chance of an entry cell from 0.041 to 0.090 (lift 2.2; fires on 47% of panel cells). A calendar announcement for any provider in the panel lifts it 3.9x (entries cluster in the Nebius repricing week). A thin panel (one-offer-out fragility > 5%) does not lift it (0.69x).
dated_examples: 2026-10-02 h=1 gpurentalprices.neocloud_rate_card.A100_40GB.on_demand: 3-offer panel, lambdalabs adds listings, median 1.294 -> 1.990; S3 q50 1.296, q90 1.302.
2026-09-30 h=3 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.B300.on_demand: together enters while nebius, fal and verda raise prices, median 7.625 -> 9.148; S3 q90 7.790.
modes.scope: Scope: 37 rental_headline series, dev cells (origins 2026-08-18..2026-10-06, h=1,3,7, n=4,278), offer panel rows <= 2026-10-13. S3 = ens of mix, gbm, chronos_last replay, fm2 bs16, analog k600, prov L1 W21 dyn (dev skill 0.2036). Cause of an h-day move from the origin->target panel decomposition of experiments/autopsy (Shapley split for mixed cells); dynamic = pivotal provider repriced on >15% of its observed days in the 21 days to the origin (headline offers on that collector); announced = calendar entry for that provider and GPU published <= origin with effective day (+collector lag) in (origin, target].

modes.name: Repricing by a dynamic provider
modes.definition: The pivotal provider reprices often (>15% of days in the trailing 21) and the move is mostly repricing of surviving offers.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Yes: the provider's own trailing reprice rate and signed drift, which prov already uses. This is the cause iteration 2 fixed most.
dated_examples: 2026-09-13 h=7 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.B300.on_demand: verda staircase, 7.50 -> 7.85; S3 q10=q50=q90=7.50 (prov gate closed, every member flat).
2026-09-21 h=7 gpurentalprices.neocloud_rate_card.B300.on_demand: verda up, scaleway down, 8.239 -> 8.502; S3 q90 8.297.

modes.name: Announced one-off repricing by a static provider
modes.definition: A provider that rarely reprices raises a price on a date published in the repricing calendar before the origin.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Yes, fully: date and size are in data_out/repricing_calendar.jsonl. The calendar fires on 3.8% of panel cells with 47% precision for an up-move >5% (base rate 6.3%), and flags 54% of S3's up-move loss. S3 does not use it.
dated_examples: 2026-10-01 h=7 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.B300.on_demand: nebius +21% effective 2026-10-01 (published 2026-09-16), median 7.625 -> 9.153; S3 q90 7.920.
2026-09-27 h=7 gpurentalprices.neocloud_rate_card.B300.on_demand: same nebius change, 8.460 -> 9.500; S3 q90 8.683.

modes.name: Marketplace ask noise
modes.definition: The single marketplace ask series (gpurentalprices H100_80GB spot: sfcompute, spheron) moves daily.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Volatility yes (recent volatility; fm2 and chronos track it), direction no. S1 -> S2 fixed most of it (0.71 -> 0.62); S3 adds nothing.
dated_examples: 2026-08-18 h=7 gpurentalprices.marketplace_ask.H100_80GB.spot: sfcompute ask up, 1.090 -> 1.760; S3 q90 1.516.

modes.name: Offer leaves the panel
modes.definition: The median moves because a provider's offer disappears from the panel and composition outweighs repricing.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Size yes (the one-offer-out median of the origin panel), timing no. No system improved it: loss/last value 0.97 (S0) to 0.94 (S3). At h=7, 67% of exit cells fall below S3's q10.
dated_examples: 2026-09-29 h=7 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.H100_PCIe_80GB.on_demand: thundercompute leaves (quantacloud enters lower), 3.20 -> 2.59; S3 q10=q90=3.20.
2026-10-01 h=1 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.A100_40GB.on_demand: modal leaves a 4-offer panel, 1.642 -> 1.294; S3 q10 1.639.

modes.name: Unannounced one-off repricing
modes.definition: A provider that was static in the trailing 21 days reprices without a calendar entry.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Weakly. 61% of the up-move cells in this class sit in panels where another provider has an announced change (the 2026-10-01 B200/B300 week: fal, verda, gmi move with nebius). The provider having raised this GPU on the other collector in the last 7 days has precision 0.38 but fires on 0.6% of cells. Verda's staircase after a 3-week pause lands here (rate21 = 0).
dated_examples: 2026-09-30 h=3 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.B200.on_demand: fal raises with nebius and verda in the same week, 6.470 -> 7.522; S3 q90 6.544.
2026-09-12 h=7 fastgpu_daily.neocloud_rate_card.B300.on_demand: verda resumes its staircase after no reprice in 21 days, 7.50 -> 7.85; S3 interval zero width.

modes.name: Hyperscaler spot (afhubbard)
modes.definition: Moves in the four afhubbard spot series (aws, azure, gcp, oci regional spot snapshots).
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Little. Changes cluster in time (afhubbard EDA) but no member exploits it beyond that; S3 is slightly worse than S2 here (0.695 vs 0.682).
dated_examples: 2026-09-03 h=7 afhubbard.hyperscaler_spot.A100_40GB.spot: aws and gcp regional spot moves, 2.248 -> 2.135; S3 q10 2.235.
2026-09-28 h=1 afhubbard.hyperscaler_spot.V100.spot: gcp spot up, 1.375 -> 1.475; S3 q90 1.388.

modes.name: Width cost on cells that did not move
modes.definition: Loss on cells whose value is unchanged at the target; all of it is interval width.
modes.visible_in_panel_at_origin: Partly: whether a series moves is predictable (AUC 0.83, H16), and prov's gate already zeroes width on static panels.
dated_examples: dev-wide: 2,211 no-move cells carry 4.2% of S3 loss (2.5% at h=7).
